newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Petsec says oil, gas production up in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Petsec says oil, gas production up in Q1.

text.p: Petsec Energy Ltd said on Monday its production for the March quarter was 919,282 barrels of oil and 7.275 billion cubic feet (bcf) of gas.
This was up 50 percent on the December quarter and the company expected production to grow as new discoveries came on stream, chairman Adrian Fletcher told the annual general meeting.
Fletcher said oil and gas from exploration wells drilled so far in 1997 had increased gross proven and probable reserves by 33 bcf of gas and 1.6 million barrels of oil.
Petsec said gross proven and probable reserves at the end of 1996 stood at 132 bcf and 13.8 million barrels of oil.
Fletcher said Petsec planned to drill 15 wells in 1997 as part of US$120 million exploration and development budget.

Petsec, which operates in the Gulf of Mexico, recently changed its balance date from June 30 to December 31 to bring its reporting period into line with U.S. oil companies to allow for better financial comparsion.
The company also recently changed its name from Petroleum Securities Australia Ltd.
Petsec reported a net profit for calendar 1996 of A$21.57 million, compared with A$6.76 million in 1995.
At 11.40 a.m. (0140 GMT), Petsec shares were five cents lower at A$4.85.
